name: Implement and debug visual interface components
description: Users asked for assistance with implementing, debugging, or optimizing visual user interface features, with a dominant focus on canvas manipulation, image processing, and dynamic animations. The requests covered specific tasks such as rendering interactive diagrams, handling element sizing and scaling, creating custom sliders or carousels, and troubleshooting pixel-perfect interactions across various web and mobile development frameworks.
